scripts.title: Flexer V2 (GET ANY FPS)
scripts.features:
Flexer V2 - the only unpatched script for "Flex Your FPS And Ping"

- Your fake FPS and ping will be seen by everyone in the server

- Lets you change your FPS and ping to any number
- Lets you make your FPS look realistic
- Lets you copy another player's FPS or ping
- Bypasses the game's anticheat

NOTES:
- Your executor must support getconnections (so executors like Solara will not support this script)
- The displayed ping will only be an approximation of your target ping
- The maximum possible FPS is 9998
- You will have to wait (target ping / 1000) seconds for your desired ping to show up (so if you enter a ping of 10,000, you must wait 10 seconds)
